summary.prose: Fix premature chat completion by linking each new Claude request to its own native result, preserving replies after queued work finishes first. Extend retained-output replay so older turns also keep their outcome across repeated reloads, then validate live, resumed and background-process behavior with provider-specific tests.

Read only complete lines before the saved offset, without polling or crossing segment boundaries; retain default tail behavior. Add temporary-file regressions for multiple turns, rollover, byte boundaries, abort and SegmentGone.

tasks.title: Correlate Claude requests and native completion

Classify new-turn Claude result completion by exact singular/list UUID correlation for live and resume, never by result order or heuristics. Preserve own result failures/empty completion and process-scoped lease/stop behavior, checkpoint handled terminal lines, and report missing trustworthy completion or input errors without duplicate retry. Adapt existing fixtures to dynamic request IDs and add failing-before/passing-after queued-result regressions.

Missing/throwing stdin, malformed/missing correlation and clean/nonzero exit produce clear failures rather than false success or duplicated submissions.
Identity survives midstream reload; ignored/terminal cursor progress is correct.
